users.title: Users
users.description: Accounts registered in the client app and their status. Admin console accounts are managed under Admins.
users.statusHint: Disabling signs the user out of the client app everywhere.
users.deletionConfirmDescription: The user is signed out everywhere. After the grace period the account and all of its data (knowledge bases, files, exports) are purged permanently. Until then the user can restore it from the sign-in page; disable the account as well to prevent that.

admins.title: Admins
admins.description: Accounts that sign in to this console, their roles and status. They are separate from client app users.
admins.createDescription: Admin accounts can only sign in to this console, not to the client app.
admins.initialPasswordHint: 8-72 characters. The admin can change it under Settings after signing in.
admins.cannotDisableSelf: You cannot disable your own account.
admins.statusHint: Disabling signs the admin out everywhere.
admins.created: Admin {email} created. Share the initial password with them securely.
admins.resetMfaDescription: Use this when they lost their authenticator and recovery codes. They are signed out everywhere and sign in with the password alone until they turn it on again.
admins.mfaReset: Two-factor authentication reset. The admin has been signed out everywhere.

roles.title: Roles
roles.description: Bundle permissions into roles and assign them to admin accounts.
roles.dialogDescription: Users get the union of the permissions of all their roles. Changes apply immediately.
roles.codeHint: Stable identifier used in code and seeds.

auditLogs.title: Audit Log
auditLogs.description: Changes made through the API by admins and client users, including rejected and failed requests.
auditLogs.detailDescription: Passwords, tokens and API keys are stored as [redacted].

systemSettings.title: System Settings
systemSettings.description: Feature flags and limits that take effect on every server instance within seconds, without a restart.
systemSettings.readOnly: You can view these settings. Changing them needs the setting:manage permission.
systemSettings.envHint: Infrastructure, secrets and security switches such as the audit log are configured through environment variables and are not listed here.

registrationEnabled.title: Allow client sign-up
registrationEnabled.description: When off, the client app hides sign-up and the server rejects registrations and registration codes (AUTH_REGISTRATION_DISABLED). Existing users can still sign in.

passwordResetTtlSeconds.title: Password reset link lifetime (seconds)
passwordResetTtlSeconds.description: How long an emailed password reset link stays valid. Applies to links sent afterwards; the maximum is PASSWORD_RESET_TTL_SECONDS.

emailCodeTtlSeconds.title: Email code lifetime (seconds)
emailCodeTtlSeconds.description: How long an emailed verification code stays valid. Applies to codes sent afterwards; the maximum is EMAIL_CODE_TTL_SECONDS.

emailCodeResendSeconds.title: Email code resend interval (seconds)
emailCodeResendSeconds.description: Minimum wait before another code can be sent to the same address. It can only be raised above EMAIL_CODE_RESEND_SECONDS.

emailCodeMaxAttempts.title: Wrong code attempts
emailCodeMaxAttempts.description: How many wrong guesses a verification code allows before it is discarded.

defaultLimit.title: Requests per window
defaultLimit.description: Requests one IP may send to one endpoint within THROTTLE_TTL_SECONDS before getting 429. Can only be lowered below THROTTLE_LIMIT.

authLimit.title: Credential requests per window
authLimit.description: Limit for sign-in, sign-up, codes, password reset and two-factor endpoints per IP within AUTH_THROTTLE_TTL_SECONDS. Can only be lowered below AUTH_THROTTLE_LIMIT; lower it during credential stuffing.

adminTtlSeconds.title: Admin session lifetime (seconds)
adminTtlSeconds.description: Admin console sessions end this long after sign-in, however often they refresh (28800 = 8 hours). Applies to new sign-ins; the maximum is REFRESH_TOKEN_TTL_SECONDS.

clientIdleTtlSeconds.title: Client session idle timeout (seconds)
clientIdleTtlSeconds.description: Client sessions expire after this long without activity; every token refresh restarts it (86400 = 1 day). The maximum is REFRESH_TOKEN_TTL_SECONDS.

clientMaxTtlSeconds.title: Client session maximum lifetime (seconds)
clientMaxTtlSeconds.description: Client users must sign in again this long after signing in, even when active. The maximum is CLIENT_SESSION_MAX_TTL_SECONDS.

deletionGraceDays.title: Deletion grace period (days)
deletionGraceDays.description: How long a client user can restore their account after requesting deletion. Applies to new requests only; 0 purges it in the next nightly run.

authRecordRetentionDays.title: Session record retention (days)
authRecordRetentionDays.description: How long expired or revoked sessions and used or expired reset tokens are kept before the nightly cleanup; 0 keeps them forever.

storageOrphanSweepEnabled.title: Sweep orphaned files
storageOrphanSweepEnabled.description: Every day at 04:00, delete avatars, knowledge base sources and exports that no record references anymore.

retentionDays.title: Keep notifications (days)
retentionDays.description: Personal notifications older than this are deleted every night at 03:20, read or not. 0 keeps them forever. Announcements are not affected.

embeddingModels.title: Embedding Models
embeddingModels.description: Models that turn knowledge base documents into vectors. New knowledge bases use the default model.
embeddingModels.deleteHint: Models used by a knowledge base cannot be deleted.
embeddingModels.dialogDescription: Any OpenAI-compatible /embeddings API: Ollama, vLLM, Xinference, TEI, SiliconFlow, OpenAI...
embeddingModels.lockedHint: Model and dimensions are locked once a knowledge base uses this model; create a new model instead.
embeddingModels.apiKeyKeepPlaceholder: Stored - leave blank to keep it
embeddingModels.apiKeyHint: Stored encrypted and never shown again.
embeddingModels.useAsDefault: Use as default for new knowledge bases
embeddingModels.noValidEmbedding: The provider did not return a valid embedding.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Manage your profile and account security.

profile.description: This is how others will see you on the site.
profile.nicknameHint: This is your public display name.
profile.emailHint: Used to sign in and to receive password reset links.
profile.rolesHint: Roles are assigned by an administrator.

security.description: Change your password and review where you are signed in.
security.newPasswordHint: 8-72 characters. Every other session will be signed out.
security.changed: Password changed. Your other sessions have been signed out.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactor.description: Ask for a code from an authenticator app after your password, so a leaked password alone cannot sign in.
twoFactor.offHint: Off. Use an authenticator app such as Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or 1Password.
twoFactor.scanStep: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app, then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
twoFactor.qrAlt: QR code for the authenticator app
twoFactor.manualEntry: Cannot scan it? Enter this key in the app:
twoFactor.codesDescription: If you lose your authenticator, each code signs you in once. They are shown only now, so copy or download them and keep them safe.
twoFactor.enabled: Two-factor authentication is on. Your other sessions have been signed out.
twoFactor.disableDescription: Confirm with your password and a current authentication code or a recovery code.
twoFactor.regenerateDescription: Your current recovery codes stop working. Confirm with your password and a current authentication code or a recovery code.

sessions.title: Active sessions
sessions.description: Sign out of devices you no longer use.

customTheme.title: Customize
customTheme.description: Pick a style and color for your components.

menuStyles.vercelDescription: Click to navigate to the next level

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Messages about your account and announcements from administrators.

passwordChanged.title: Your password was changed
passwordChanged.body: Other devices were signed out. If this was not you, reset your password right away.

twoFactorChanged.title: Two-factor authentication changed
twoFactorChanged.body: Two-factor authentication of your account was {change}. If this was not you, contact an administrator.

deletionCancelled.title: Account deletion cancelled
deletionCancelled.body: Your account has been restored and will not be deleted.

documentReady.title: Document ready

documentFailed.title: Document processing failed
documentFailed.body: "{title}" could not be indexed. Check the file and upload it again.

preferences.title: Notifications
preferences.description: Choose how you hear about events of your account.
preferences.mandatoryHint: Security notifications cannot be turned off.
preferences.loadFailed: Notification preferences could not be loaded.

announcements.title: Announcements
announcements.description: Messages to client users, administrators or everyone. Published announcements appear right away in their notification center.
announcements.readOnly: You can view announcements. Writing them needs the announcement:manage permission.
announcements.createDescription: Save a draft or publish it right away.

fields.title: Title
fields.bodyHint: Plain text; line breaks are kept.
fields.expiresAtHint: Optional. Hidden from the audience from then on.

announcements.deleteDescription: It disappears for everyone, including who already read it. This cannot be undone.
